{{Quote|Do you know where ''[Ghez Hokan]'' is?''"<br />"''They're down at the farm the Kirmay clan used to own before Hokan sold them to Trandoshans. About fifty, maybe sixty of them. What are you going to do to us?|RC-1136 and a Qiiluran villager|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
The [[Kirmay clan]] owned a '''farm''' located on the<ref name="RC:HC" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. [[Ghez Hokan]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] hired by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], sold the Kirmay clan to [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], which was explained to [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] by a [[Unidentified villager (Qiilura)|Qiiluran villager]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Commando/Legends|commando's]] [[Mission to Qiilura|mission]] to capture Separatist [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]]. The villager further estimated that the [[Farm/Legends|farm]], which was then repurposed as a staging ground, held about fifty to sixty of Hokan's mercenaries.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kirmay clan's farm was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
